name: Speaking with Nezzliok
summary: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Nezzliok's severed head speaks from a bubbling cauldron. The Bloodscalp witch doctor knows where Yenniku was taken, but demands a grim tribute before he tells you.

sections.title: A Spirit's Price
sections.body: Nezzliok remains bound in the bubbling cauldron after the hunt for Bloodscalp Clan Heads. He knows where Yenniku was taken, but gives up nothing freely. Bring three trophy skulls from the rival Skullsplitter tribe to his resting place. Then his departed spirit can command thralls in the Nether.

sections.title: Skulls of the Rivals
sections.body: Nezzliok demands one skull from the Skullsplitter trophy pile at Balia'mah, one from Ziata'jai, and one from Zul'Mamwe. All three offerings must lie beside his own head before the dead witch doctor will consider his spirit satisfied.

faq.answer: Nezzliok was a witch doctor of the Bloodscalp tribe. After he fell in battle, his severed head was placed in a bubbling cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp. His bound spirit still speaks there.
Nezzliok demands three trophy skulls from the camps of his hated rivals, the Skullsplitters. Take one from Balia'mah, one from Ziata'jai, and one from Zul'Mamwe.

faq.q: Why does Nezzliok want Skullsplitter trophies?
faq.answer: Nezzliok wants the trophy skulls placed beside him so that, when his spirit passes into the Nether, he will have three servants bound to him in death.
The encounter takes place at the bubbling cauldron in Grom'gol Base Camp, deep in Stranglethorn Vale.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you bargain with a bound enemy spirit at Grom'gol Base Camp to learn what happened to Yenniku, the son of the Darkspear chieftain.
As a Darkspear troll, you bargain with the severed head of a hostile Bloodscalp witch doctor to learn what became of your chieftain's stolen son.
